newsitem.title: JAPAN: JT shares extend losses on U.S. settlement.
newsitem.headline: JT shares extend losses on U.S. settlement.

text.p: Japan Tobacco Inc shares fell on Tuesday morning, extending the previous day's losses.

Concerns over the domestic tobacco industry grew after news on Friday that the U.S. tobacco industry, health advocates and 40 states suing the industry had reached a $368.5 billion landmark settlement, traders said.
Japan Tobacco shares ended the morning down 27,000 yen at 891,000.
"Concerns lingered in the market that the U.S. settlement might affect the domestic industry," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
